event_summary: A yellow-green ball moves from the left across a tabletop, goes onto an inclined brown board, then moves back left and exits the frame.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a static tabletop setup: a brown inclined board rests on a blue block at the right, and a black cylindrical object is partly visible at the left edge. After a long still interval, a yellow-green ball enters from the left, travels rightward across the tabletop toward the lower end of the board, appears on the inclined board, reaches a higher position on the board, then moves back leftward off the board and across the tabletop until it exits near the left edge.

reasons: The inclined board, blue support block, tabletop, and black cylinder are visible before the ball appears.
The moving ball is not present in the first frame.
